attributes.name: Tangle Trap
attributes.powers:
Reveal a weapon that has the Slashing trait to add 1d4 to your checks against this barrier.

If undefeated, display this barrier next to its location deck. Characters cannot move or be moved from this location while this barrier is next to it. At the start of your turn, succeed at a Constitution or Fortitude 5 check or bury the top card of your deck; if you succeed, banish this barrier.

corrections.corrected_text: Make one or both of these changes only if you're looking for an easier time with Wrath B scenarios.On the B and C henchman Tangle Trap, add the line "If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from."Move some or all of the following cards from Set B and/or C to Set 1, and change their set indicators to 1: the barrier Arboreal Blight (B & C), the monster Carrion Golem (B & C), and 1 of the Demonic Horde barriers in B and/or the Demonic Horde barrier currently in C. Then move some or all of the following cards from Set 1 to Set B, and change their set indicators to B: the monster Accursed Priest and the barrier Poisoned Spiked Pit Trap.
corrections.issue: The B scenarios in Wrath are really hard! What if I don't want them to be so hard?

changes.explanation: No problem. If you'd like an easier run, make these optional changes.

fragments.expected: If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

changes.instruction:
Make one or both of these changes only if you're looking for an easier time with Wrath B scenarios.
On the B and C henchman Tangle Trap, add the line "If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from."
Move some or all of the following cards from Set B and/or C to Set 1, and change their set indicators to 1: the barrier Arboreal Blight (B & C), the monster Carrion Golem (B & C), and 1 of the Demonic Horde barriers in B and/or the Demonic Horde barrier currently in C.  Then move some or all of the following cards from Set 1 to Set B, and change their set indicators to B: the monster Accursed Priest and the barrier Poisoned Spiked Pit Trap.
changes.question: The B scenarios in Wrath are really hard! What if I don't want them to be so hard?
changes.review_note: Paizo explicitly offers this as an optional change. Retain the original wording and the option separately; absence is not a missing mandatory erratum.
